name: 10pines-c6-tuslibros-iteracion3
title: TusLibros Iteration 3: Merchant Processor Simulation
description: Third iteration of TusLibros.com: the cashier debits the sale's total through a Merchant Processor collaborator (debit:from:) that the tests simulate with a configurable block; when the debit fails the error reaches the caller and nothing is registered in the sales book. The cart and cashier code of iterations 1 and 2 is given.
source: 10Pines-Capacitacion/C6 - Construccion de Software Seguro usando Test Driven Development

design.notes: The Merchant Processor charges per call, so the cashier must depend on a collaborator the test replaces (the test case itself, with a block per test); the checkout is split into calculate, debit and register so the failure leaves the sales book untouched.
